court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
case_name: Vimalbai Sitaram Prajapati vs The State Of Mah & Ors

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Vimalbai w/o Sitaram Prajapati, Age 45 years, Occ. Labour
parties.respondent_defendant: The State of Maharashtra Through Police Inspector Amalner Police Station, Prakash @ Nana s/o Kashinath Kumbhar, Sundarlal s/o Kashinath Kumbhar, Mrs. Sayabai w/o Kashinath Kumbhar

facts_of_case: Marriage of deceased Ratnabai was solemnized with accused Prakash. Deceased Ratnabai was sent for cohabitation at the house of accused persons. She narrated instances of ill-treatment on account of demand of golden ornament.

legal_principles.principle: There must be a reasonable nexus between the cruelty and suicide.
legal_principles.held: Mere proof of suicide is not sufficient. There must be a reasonable nexus between the cruelty and suicide.
cited_cases: Ravindra Pyarelal Bidlan and others vs. State of Maharashtra, (1993) CRI.L.J. 3019
State of Maharashtra vs. Ashok Chotelal Shukla, (1997) AIR 3111 SC

legal_principles.principle: The prosecution must establish the factum of cruelty as defined under Section 498-A of I.P.C.
legal_principles.held: The prosecution has succeeded in establishing the factum of cruelty as defined under Section 498-A of I.P.C.
cited_cases: Reema Aggarwal vs. Anupam and others, (2004) AIR 1418 SC
